description: This is a PHP source file defining the Weight class, which extends a Model class within the OpenCart framework. The class provides a method getQuote() to calculate shipping weights based on geo zones, rates, and configuration, indicating it is part of the shipping module for weight-based shipping calculations.

classes.name: Weight
classes.description: A class handling weight-based shipping calculations, including obtaining shipping quotes based on geo zones and configured rates.

methods.name: getQuote
methods.description: Calculates shipping costs based on the provided address, current weight, geo zones, and rate configurations; returns an array with shipping quote details.
